outputs: Essays on banning smoking in restaurants and importance of part-time jobs
The paper generates essays on two prompts: banning smoking in restaurants and the importance of part-time jobs, using 12 modern LLMs across diverse author personas.

changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate task entry, normalized dataset names, and simplified output description
Removed text analysis features that are not evaluation metrics for generated outputs. Kept only Accuracy and FPR which are the actual evaluation metrics used.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper

overall_notes: The paper focuses on AI-generated text detection evaluation using statistical methods (ANOVA, WLS) to analyze bias across author demographics. It uses LLMs for text generation but evaluates detection performance using traditional metrics like accuracy and FPR. The extraction was mostly accurate but included some text analysis features that aren't evaluation metrics.
